caption: The drawing depicts a tall, elegant piece of furniture, likely a highboy chest or similar cabinet, rendered in black ink on a beige background. The piece has an ornate, symmetrical design with two distinct main sections. The upper section features a central arched compartment with a fan motif and round pull, flanked by three drawers on each side, each with decorative handles. Above this is a curved and scrolled crown, capped by three finials, the two outermost topped with shapes resembling flames or twisted ornaments shaded in yellow. The lower section includes five drawers, four square and one central rectangular, with the central drawer also featuring a radiating fan motif matching the upper compartment. The chest stands on four tall, slender, cabriole legs with pad feet, and the apron between the legs is softly scalloped. Fine lines delineate drawer edges, handle details, and decorative elements, with measurement notations present along the right and bottom edges. Some pencil notes and faint erasures are visible on the left side of the paper.
title: Chest
